verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at https://cloudconvert.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes itself as the CloudConvert API documentation. A second llms.txt under /docs lists the API's operations (optimize, watermark, archive, metadata, custom ffmpeg commands), so an agent has a curated, agent-oriented entry point into the docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or markdown page exports, and no independent report of agents actually consuming it successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
